question.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 1 & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}]$
question.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & ={a}_{11}{C}_{11}+{a}_{12}{C}_{12}+{a}_{13}{C}_{13}+{a}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =0\cdot {C}_{11}+8\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =8{C}_{12} \\  & =8\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & 8 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -1 & ∗ & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & ∗ & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & ∗ & -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =8(-1)^{1+2}|\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 6 & 2 \\ 1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =-8((-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}6 & 2 \\ -1 & 2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 1 & -1\end{aligned}|) \\  & =8(6\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot 2)-0+0 \\  & =8\cdot 14 \\  & =112\end{aligned}
$$
